CUET PG Result 2026 Out @cuet.nta.nic.in

The Result 2026 has been released on the NTA website for the written exam held rom 6th March 2026 to 27th March 2026. The result is released in PDF format on the official website. Candidates can download the result PDF to check their qualification status. Those who qualify the written exam will be called for university-specific counselling.

CUET PG Result 2026: Overview

The CUET PG Result 2026 is released for the written exam. The CUET cut-off will be released by the participating universities later based on seats, applicant scores, and exam difficulty. Check the table below for more details:

Particulars Details

CUET PG Exam Date 6th March 2026 to 27th March 2026

Mode of Exam Online
Next Stages Counselling, Merit List, Document Verfication
Official Website cuet.nta.nic.in

CUET PG Result 2026 Link

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the CUET PG result 2026 on its portal. The link for the same is now active to check and download the individual result. To get the result, candidates have to fill in their application number and password. The direct link to download the result is provided here. Click on the official link provided here to check your CUET PG scorecard.

CUET PG Result 2026 – Direct Link

How to Check CUET PG Result 2026?

The result of CUET PG Exam 2026 is now available on the official website of the National Testing Agency(NTA). Candidates can easily download their result by following these simple steps:

  1. Visit the official NTA website.
  2. Go to the candidates’ activity section and click on the “Result” link.
  3. Enter Application Number and Password.
  4. Click on the Login button.
  5. Your scorecard will appear on the screen.
  6. Download it and take a printout for future reference.

CUET PG College List

Details Mentioned on CUET PG Result 2026 PDF

NTA has released the results in the form of a PDF comprising the roll numbers of all the shortlisted candidates. Candidates are advised to check all the details carefully mentioned in the result PDF. The information provided in the CUET PG 2026 result is mentioned below.

  • Roll number
  • Category of the candidate
  • subject-wise marks
  • overall scores
  • percentile ranking
  • Qualification Status

CUET PG Counselling 2026?

After the declaration of the CUET PG written exam results, the exam authority is going to conduct the CUET PG Counselling Round. The details for counselling round will be shared by the participating universities. Candidates are advised to keep checking the official website regularly to get the latest updates on the counselling schedule, document requirements, and the final merit list.

CUET PG Result FAQs

Q1: When was the CUET PG Result 2026 declared?
Ans: The CUET PG Result 2026 is declared on 24th April 2026 on the official website.

Q2: How can I check the CUET PG Result 2026?
Ans: Candidates can check the Result by visiting the official website, clicking on the result link, logging in with their email and password and downloading the scorecard.

Q3: What details are mentioned in the Result PDF?
Ans: The Result PDF includes personal details, subject-wise marks, overall scores, percentile ranking, roll number and qualification status. Candidates should carefully verify all information mentioned in the result.

Q4: What happens after qualifying the CUET PG Exam?
Ans: Candidates who pass the CUET PG written exam will be called for counselling.

Q5: Is the Result released for the exam conducted from 6th to 27th March 2026?
Ans: Yes, the Result 2026 is released for the exam conducted from 6th to 27th March 2026.
